result.description:
I have a custom productivity system and this little guy helps me log pomodoros 🍅 I used Genspark Design to build the whole mobile UI. Gave it my assets, walked through the screens I wanted, and it even suggested widgets and notifications I hadn't even thought of.

result.title: Just Build It
result.description:
Been building with Arduino lately.

When it breaks, there are no signs or error message, the light just doesn't come on.

Genuinely the most I've learned from failing at something in a while.

#hardware #arduino #learning
